pp_tip.appearance_lead: Markup and stylesheet of the donation bar in the overlay.
pp_tip.bind.fill: The progress bar – its width comes from both amounts.
pp_tip.bind.title: The name of the running goal.
pp_tip.cancelled: The donation was cancelled – nothing was charged.
pp_tip.confirm_delete: Really delete the goal “%{name}”? The amount collected so far goes with it.
pp_tip.credentials_forgotten: PayPal access deleted. The donation page no longer accepts anything.
pp_tip.credentials_where: Both are in your PayPal developer account under “Apps & Credentials”. Mind whether you are on “Sandbox” or “Live” there – the keys differ.
pp_tip.done.already_hint: This donation was already booked – nothing was charged twice. Thank you!
pp_tip.done.failed: The payment did not go through
pp_tip.done.failed_hint: PayPal did not complete it. If money was charged anyway, say so in chat – it will be booked by hand.
pp_tip.done.thanks_hint: Your donation of %{amount} € arrived. The bar in the stream will grow in a moment.
pp_tip.done.unknown: This donation is not known here
pp_tip.done.unknown_hint: Nothing is on file for this PayPal payment. If money was charged, say so in chat.
pp_tip.empty: No donation goal yet. Create one – donations always go to the topmost.
pp_tip.error.goal_gone: This donation goal no longer exists. Please pick another one.
pp_tip.error.no_approve_url: PayPal did not return an address to pay at. Please try again in a moment.
pp_tip.error.no_identity: Twitch did not return a channel for this login. Please try again.
pp_tip.error.not_signed_in: The login has expired. Please sign in with Twitch again.
pp_tip.error.paypal_down: PayPal is not responding right now. Please try again in a moment.
pp_tip.error.rate_limit: Too many requests to PayPal. Please wait a moment.
pp_tip.error.terms: Without accepting the terms and the privacy policy this cannot continue.
pp_tip.error.too_large: This page does not accept more than %{max} € per donation.
pp_tip.error.unauthorized: PayPal refuses the access. Client ID and secret are probably wrong – or they belong to the other mode (sandbox instead of live).
pp_tip.fee_hint: This only computes the suggestion when someone ticks “cover the fees”. What PayPal actually deducts shows up in the settlement – and that is the value that lands on the goal.
pp_tip.format_hint: data-format="euro" shows amounts with two decimals and a currency sign, data-format="int" as a whole number.
pp_tip.is_default: The shipped appearance is in use. As soon as you save something, your version applies – and fixes to the default will no longer reach you.
pp_tip.last_failed: Something went wrong with PayPal last time:
pp_tip.legal_hint: The plugin does not ship this text – it is yours. An imprint carries your name and address; a plugin bringing one along would spread your details to everyone who installs it.
pp_tip.legal_markdown: Markdown is allowed: ## for headings, * for lists, a blank line for a paragraph.
pp_tip.missing_hint: Required elements are missing from the markup – it was saved anyway:
pp_tip.name: Tip-Goals – PayPal
pp_tip.needs_imprint: Without an imprint the donation page stays closed. A page that accepts money has to say who receives it.
pp_tip.no_script_hint: script, iframe, object, embed, style and attributes like onclick are stripped from the markup – this is about appearance.
pp_tip.perm.edit: may create, change, move and delete donation goals and store the access data.
pp_tip.public.anonymous: Your name will not show up in the stream - the donation still will.
pp_tip.public.closed_hint: This page is not accepting donations at the moment. Come back later.
pp_tip.public.footer: Straight to %{name}, with no platform in between - only PayPal's own fees apply.
pp_tip.public.heading: Support %{name}
pp_tip.public.lead: Straight through PayPal, no platform in between. Your Twitch name appears in the stream if you want it to.
pp_tip.public.message_hint: Shown with the donation alert in the stream.
pp_tip.public.message_placeholder: e.g. Thanks for the great streams!
pp_tip.public.net_warn: Donation goals and alerts use the amount that arrives after PayPal's fees have been deducted.
pp_tip.public.no_goal_hint: Arrives just the same, it simply does not count towards a progress bar.
pp_tip.public.not_ready: No PayPal access is stored here yet – nothing can be accepted right now.
pp_tip.public.paypal_hint: You will continue at PayPal. Payment happens there – nothing happens until then.
pp_tip.public.terms: I have read and accept the %{terms} and the %{privacy}. I confirm that I am at least 18 years old.
pp_tip.public.why_login: The login only serves to show your name in the stream. No account is created.
pp_tip.public_hint: This is the address you share:
pp_tip.required_hint: Without these elements the bar shows nothing in the overlay – and that only becomes apparent mid-stream.
pp_tip.reset_question: Discard your own markup and stylesheet and use the shipped one again?
pp_tip.scope_hint: Keep your rules inside .goal-tip. An unscoped rule describes the same classes as the Twitch goals – then their bars look different depending on load order.
pp_tip.secret_set: stored – leave empty to keep it
pp_tip.settings_lead: Token and channel ID used to fetch the donations.
pp_tip.title: Name
pp_tip.too_many: More than %{max} goals is no longer a list.
